tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page behind everything: lists, day headers, the ground under cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, text fields, chips and round icon buttons.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: secondary buttons, segmented controls, code, the copies badge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body copy on bg, surface and surface-2 (15.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on bg and surface: time, place, captions, sub lines. On surface-2 in light it is 4.27:1, below the 4.5:1 floor: avoid muted text on surface-2 in light mode.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and decorative marks (rules, dots, glyphs) only. It is under 4.5:1 on every ground (2.5:1 light, 4.0:1 dark), so never use it for text someone must read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row dividers, quiet card borders, text field borders and the ring around site icons.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button on a screen, selected chips and the active segment.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (18.7:1 light, 15.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links (weight 600), the unread dot and line, progress bars, hover titles and 2px focus rings. It is ink on purpose: the screens stay neutral and the logo keeps the only strong colour.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Vermilion. The app icon, favicon, link preview and the logo on the sign-in screen. Never buttons, links or text in the working screens.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: The ticket and anything else placed on brand (4.5:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as text on bg and surface (5.1:1 or more), and the fill of a destructive primary button with on-danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill: white in light (5.6:1), near-black in dark (7.6:1). The app currently uses white in both, which is 2.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: going
tokens.usage: Going status text on going-bg (4.6:1 light, 7.8:1 dark), and the ok tick.

tokens.name: going-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Going pill and a strong match tag.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Waitlist status text on wait-bg (5.4:1, 8.2:1), and headings on the clash card.

tokens.name: wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Waitlist pill and the clash card.

tokens.name: invited
tokens.usage: Invited status text on invited-bg (5.1:1, 8.2:1). Also count badges, the New match tag, update tags and Met markers. Teal replaces the old violet.

tokens.name: invited-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Invited pill and everything that borrows it.

tokens.name: host
tokens.usage: Hosting status text on host-bg (5.4:1, 7.6:1).

tokens.name: host-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Hosting pill.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending status text on pending-bg (5.3:1, 7.4:1): the agent is working on it.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Pending pill.

tokens.name: needs
tokens.usage: Needs-you text on needs-bg (4.5:1, 7.8:1): the agent stopped and needs a code, a payment or a login.

tokens.name: needs-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Needs-you pill, the warn chip and the Same person? card.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: day-header
styles.usage: Day headers in a list; the weekday in muted at 500.

styles.name: event-title
styles.usage: An event's name in a row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent registers you, confirms it worked, and tells you.

styles.name: sub
styles.sample: All your events in one place.
styles.usage: A screen's one-line explainer, in muted.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Time, place and counts under an event title, in muted.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: Small print and source lines, in muted.

styles.name: tile-status
styles.usage: The status pill on an event tile, and small tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Above and below each row in a list; between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The page gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Below the logo on the sign-in screen.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Widest the single column gets on a phone or narrow window.

tokens.name: column-wide
tokens.usage: The column from 960px wide, beside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The left sidebar that replaces the tab bar from 960px wide.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Height of the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Text fields and the primary button.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Filter chips.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: Event tiles in a list.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Event tiles.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, status pills and the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, round icon buttons and the tab bar.
